svg.title: AGV safety laser scanner fields vs speed with stopping distance (example)
svg.text: Safety laser scanner fields – length grows with v², switched by speed (item 1 crate AGV)
D = v·(t_scanner + t_ctrl) + v²/(2·(a − g·p))·1.1 + Z t = 0.07 + 0.10 = 0.17 s · a = 0.8 m/s² · Z = 100 mm · p = downhill slope (0 or 0.01)
real stopping distance v·t + v²/2a (no margin, no Z)
What the field length is made of (flat floor)
Field sets on the vehicle (plan, 0.12 px per mm) – the safety controller switches the set by the measured speed
Field bent to the inside of the curve
sees the wall outside the curve
Short docking field 150 mm only at
posts of the stand would stop the AGV.
